literal: From the lover / sweet words / not receiving / in the world / than those who live / hard-hearted people / are not.
translation: There is no one more hard-hearted than those who continue to live in this world without receiving sweet words from their lover.
modern: தம்மை விரும்பும் காதலரிடமிருந்து இனிய சொற்களைப் பெறாமலேயே இந்த உலகத்தில் உயிர்வாழ்கின்றவர்களை விடக் கல்நெஞ்சம் கொண்டவர்கள் வேறு யாரும் இல்லை.
explanation: The speaker, suffering from separation, reflects on her own endurance. She states that surviving in this world without hearing sweet, comforting words from her lover requires an incredibly hard heart. By saying there is no one more hard-hearted than such survivors, she is actually lamenting her own painful ability to stay alive despite the agony of his absence and silence.
